title: Fix a crash from its error message (Python)
prompt:
Running `{python} report.py` stops with this error:

    Traceback (most recent call last):
      File "report.py", line 15, in <module>
        print(summary(load("orders.json")))
      File "report.py", line 10, in summary
        total = sum(order["amount"] for order in orders)
    TypeError: unsupported operand type(s) for +: 'int' and 'str'

Some amounts in orders.json are written as text, and one order has no amount. Fix report.py so that it also reads amounts written as text and counts a missing amount as 0. Do not edit orders.json.
